headline: Dangote Explores Expanding Refinery Share Access Across African Exchanges
summary: Aliko Dangote is exploring ways to make shares in his refinery available through more African stock exchanges after its $1.6 billion initial public offering attracted approximately $4.77 billion in orders.
why: Cross-border listings and expanded retail access can increase liquidity and broaden the investor base for major African industrial assets.

impacts.name: Dangote Refinery
impacts.why: Strong initial public offering demand supports potential secondary listings across regional exchanges.
